segment.source: Renders a video from a URL inside a fixed sixteen-by-nine frame, with a poster image standing in until the player loads and a caption underneath. Use it for: a recorded talk, a product demo, an interview, an explainer on a help page, a testimonial on film. Prefer 'Captioned Image' for a still frame, and 'Text with Media' when the video should sit beside a column of prose instead of spanning the band.
